name: Sumiyoshi Hayato
source:
Hayato is an ordinary student who likes games and isn't good at studying. He has a positive personality. He is predisposed to overly simplistic thinking and jumping to conclusions.

He has feelings for his mother, Aina.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc090/index.html]the official site[/url]]
